It's where Dext starts. Every way to send paperwork Snap it, email it, upload it – every submission method Hubdoc offers, plus Invoice Fetch, which automatically retrieves invoices from your supplier accounts. Utilities, software subscriptions: they arrive in Dext before you think to look for them. Data you don't double-check Dext reads the whole document – supplier, totals, tax, payment method and full line items – with 99%+ accuracy, trained on billions of real receipts and invoices. It lands in your books ready to use, not ready to fix. Room to grow with your business Hubdoc suits a handful of simple documents a month. Dext adds AI Assist supplier rules, bank matching, expense management and approvals. So the tool you pick today still fits when your business is twice the size. AUTOMATED DOCUMENT COLLECTION Up-to-date books start with up-to-date paperwork The biggest time sink in bookkeeping isn't processing documents, it's collecting them. Dext makes submitting so easy that paperwork flows in as it's created, keeping your books current instead of a month behind. Snap and go: photograph a receipt in the mobile app and the data is extracted before you've put your phone away Email-in address: set a rule to auto-forward supplier invoices and they process themselves, invoice after invoice Upload, scan or sync from cloud storage – whatever fits the way you already work 10 years of secure storage in Dext, searchable in seconds – so you're always audit-ready Explore receipt & invoice capture ACCURACY & DEPTH OF EXTRACTION Books you can trust, without the double-checking Basic OCR gives you a date, a currency and an invoice number. Dext reads the whole document accurately, so your numbers are right the first time, whether you do the books yourself or hand them to your accountant. Over 99% accurate data capture, trained on billions of real documents – crumpled receipts and messy handwriting included Deeper field extraction: supplier, totals, tax amounts, payment method, PO numbers and full line items – not just the basics Supplier statement reconciliation: match statements against invoices to spot what's missing – not a Hubdoc capability Duplicate and anomaly detection catches mistakes before they reach your books – or your tax return INTEGRATIONS Xero owns Hubdoc. Dext integrates deeper. It's a fair assumption that Hubdoc works best with Xero. In practice, Dext exchanges more data with Xero in both directions – and connects to 36 accounting platforms, so it works whatever software you or your accountant use.
